summary: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly, with properly awaited assertions on locators. The selectors use data-test attributes, which are stable and robust for testing. The test verifies visibility of multiple product cards on the home page. While the test is somewhat verbose and could be refactored for maintainability, the core correctness and best practices are met.

issues.description: The test asserts visibility of 26 different product selectors one by one, which leads to repetitive and verbose code.
issues.recommendation: Refactor the test by using a loop or data-driven approach to check the visibility of all product cards to improve maintainability and reduce repetition.

recommendations: Consider implementing a data-driven loop to verify product selectors instead of individual assertions to improve maintainability.
Ensure the base URL is stable and correct as per the test environment; hardcoding the full URL is acceptable but consider configuration for flexibility.
No manual testCaseId found in test title; consider adding 'TC-001' in the test name for traceability if required.
